messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — planning a short night deploy: runtime-engine-2.5 + kernel-1.14 + quant-profile qprof-v3.2. Window 02:30-03:00 UTC tonight. Canary on a single slice to start. Can owners ack availability?

Sam: I can take the slot. Will do canary on slice-7 at 02:30. I'll post step confirmations. :thumbsup:

Maria: I'll handle smoke checks and perf baselines. Running the standard smoke script and will post p50/p95, error rates, and kv-hit. @Sam ping me when the canary lands.

Praveen: I'll be standby for rollback and infra watch. Trigger rollback on either latency > 25% increase vs baseline or > 3x 5xx rate spike. Also watching end-to-end traces.

Lin: Note: PR 2456 modifies kv-cache path and quant scheduler. @Maria please double-check model fallback behavior.

Alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2456 — changes include quant profile loader and kernel gating flags. Keep qprof-v3.1 in fallback list.

Sam: Short deploy plan:
1) Promote runtime-engine-2.5 to canary on slice-7 at 02:30.
2) Run smoke: ./tools/smoke_check.sh --slice slice-7 --profile qprof-v3.2
3) Wait 10m for telemetry. Maria validates traces + static perf.
4) If green, ramp to +3 slices across 20m.
5) If anything red, revert canary and re-pin qprof-v3.1.

Sam: Smoke snippet:
```
./tools/smoke_check.sh --target slice-7 --checks=latency,errors,kv-hit
# expected: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 200ms, kv-hit delta < 2%
```

Maria: Did a staging dry-run earlier. qprof-v3.2 is OK for short sequences; watch long-tail mem and occasional kv miss bump. I'll capture heap profiles during smoke.

Praveen: Rollback commands if needed:
```
kubectl -n runtime rollout undo sts/runtime-engine --to-revision=stable-2026-03
# then PATCH /api/v1/models/{model}/profile -> qprof-v3.1
```

Alex: Ops notes: keep window tight, no other infra changes during canary; disable autoscaler burst on these slices to reduce noise.

Lin: Small nit in PR — add a guard to emit a metric when profile load fails. I'll push a tiny patch; non-blocking but useful for alerting.

Sam: I'll hold slot until 02:25 UTC and post a go/no-go at 02:20 in this thread.

Maria: CR done; left one comment about the metric name. Smoke run ready on my side.

Praveen: I'll be in #eng-oncall and have rollback checklist ready. At 02:10 I'll re-check capacity and confirm no conflicting deploys.

Alex: Final owner checklist:
- Sam: deploy + rollback exec; hold slot
- Maria: smoke + perf + CR reviewer
- Praveen: infra + rollback exec
- Lin: metric guard patch if needed

Alex: If no blockers we proceed tonight. :eyes:

Sam: Go/no-go at 02:20 will be posted here.

Maria: 02:20 ack from me barring test failures.

Lin: I'll be available to ship the tiny patch during the slot if metric guard is required.

DeployBot: Scheduled runtime-engine-2.5 canary on slice-7 at 02:30 UTC (cron-id: cb-672).

Sam: Thanks all — see you in the window.
